title: Oscar and the Escarpment
author: Orsen Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Crane, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
